gist.summary: Added @fi8vni13’s CastSheet to the app catalog and README showcase. The web app uses Pollinations image generation to turn a character description and chosen style into a front, side, and back reference sheet plus a 2×2 expression grid. The README’s recent-app list now shows CastSheet in place of Summering text; the diff does not remove Summering text from the app catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy studio, Polli checks a CastSheet drawing board showing front, side, and back views of one little pixel character beside a 2×2 grid of its expressions; lime green (#ecf874) flower pots hold tiny code-plants against a warm cream and pastel gradient background. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny artist’s beret, is small-to-medium sized and shares the frame without dominating it, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, dark purple (#110518) outlines, and a subtle CRT glow.
